annotations.title: Find a Live x402 API for a Task

description: Which x402 API should my agent call? Live API finder for any task. Required: task. Returns up to 5 paid APIs that answered a fresh unpaid probe with a valid Base USDC 402, ranked by task fit, price and Bazaar-reported repeat buyers, each with live price, network and a ready-to-call request. Provider calls are paid separately. No live match, no charge. $0.005 USDC on Base. No account, no API key. Recommendations, not a safety guarantee. By Ontario Protocol. [PAID: 0.005 USDC via x402 on Base. Two-step flow: a call without payment returns MCP PaymentRequired; the retry carries the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta['x402/payment']. The legacy _x402_payment base64 argument is also supported. Signing happens in the caller's wallet.]

_x402_payment.description: base64 x402 PaymentPayload (USDC on Base); obtain the requirements by calling this tool without it first.

limit.description: Number of live-verified APIs to return, 1 to 5.

max_usdc.description: Optional per-call price ceiling in USDC for returned APIs, e.g. '0.01'.

task.description: Public task text, e.g. 'web search for an AI agent'. Never include credentials or private data.

name: ontario_find-api
title: Find a Live x402 API for a Task

x402.not_for: Not a safety certification or a guarantee that the paid response is correct. Ontario's own paid routes are excluded from results.
x402.purchase_reason: Live-checked, repeat-buyer ranked APIs for one task with the exact request and payment terms, without ghost or broken listings.
x402.selection_rule: Returns only endpoints that are payable right now for one concrete task. The free tool router returns unverified search candidates; this tool probes them and drops dead, mismatched or over-budget listings.
